origin.description: The source file (a reference) or the decision that produced this table (C04 R[0]); a table without it is code

description.description: What the table checks, in the pack language

tier.description: Tier of the outcomes (C05 R[1]); default blocking when a basis is given, else advisory. Blocking needs a basis

basis.description: The acceptance contract clause a blocking check relies on (C05 R[1])

item.description: Pointer to the item identity in the subject (or in each node); copied into outcomes

location.description: Pointer to the reference URI of the item in the judged source; becomes a ground of the outcomes

nodes.description: The nodes the rules apply to; default $ (the subject is one node); $[*] for an array of items

kind.description: Pointer to the node kind inside a node

children.description: Pointer to the child array inside a node; children are visited recursively

kinds.description: Node kinds the rule applies to (values at the `kind` pointer); absent means every node

path.description: Location of the field relative to the node

required.description: A missing field, null, a string that is empty after trimming or an empty array is core.structure.required_empty

type.description: Required JSON type; a value of another type is core.structure.type_mismatch

minimum.description: Inclusive lower bound of a number; violations are core.structure.type_mismatch

maximum.description: Inclusive upper bound of a number; violations are core.structure.type_mismatch

minLength.description: Minimum string length in code points

maxLength.description: Maximum string length in code points

minItems.description: Minimum array length; violations are core.structure.cardinality

maxItems.description: Maximum array length; violations are core.structure.cardinality

items.description: Constraints on every element of an array field

type.description: Required JSON type; a value of another type is core.structure.type_mismatch

minimum.description: Inclusive lower bound of a number; violations are core.structure.type_mismatch

maximum.description: Inclusive upper bound of a number; violations are core.structure.type_mismatch

minLength.description: Minimum string length in code points

maxLength.description: Maximum string length in code points

items.description: Constraints on one field of a node

children.description: Bounds on the number of children; violations are core.structure.cardinality

kinds.description: Count only children of these kinds

items.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; the empty string is the whole value

key.description: Fields that together form the key; nodes with an equal key are core.structure.duplicate_key

within.description: all: among every selected node of the rule; siblings: among children of one parent; group: among nodes with equal `group` fields. Default all

group.description: Fields that define the groups when within is group

items.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; the empty string is the whole value

unicode.description: Unicode normalization form applied first; default nfc

case.description: insensitive compares lower-cased values; default sensitive

whitespace.description: trim removes leading and trailing whitespace, collapse also turns every inner whitespace run into one space; default trim

match.description: How values are normalized before matching (C04 R[2]); every table that compares text declares it

items.description: Rules for nodes of some kinds

title: structure@1
description: Structure table: required fields, uniqueness keys, child cardinality bounds, value types and numeric ranges, rules per node kind. Codes: core.structure.*
